git_cases.rationale: A single escaping path inside an otherwise legitimate commit must fail the whole change.

git_cases.description: Replace a protected regular file with a symlink.
git_cases.rationale: Type changes rewrite protected content semantics without editing bytes in place.

git_cases.description: Change only the file mode of a protected file.
git_cases.rationale: A mode-only change is still a mutation of a read-only path.

git_cases.description: Add an out-of-allowlist gitlink entry.
git_cases.rationale: A submodule pointer outside the allowlist introduces external content into a read-only tree.

git_cases.description: Add an out-of-allowlist file whose name is not valid UTF-8.
git_cases.rationale: Undecodable bytes must not silently pass. Exit 2 is an acceptable fail-closed outcome; exit 0 would be a defect.

git_cases.description: Add an out-of-allowlist file whose name contains a newline.
git_cases.rationale: Newline in a protected path must not be split into two fragments that both look harmless.

git_cases.description: Change a protected file on the base side only, after the fork point.
git_cases.rationale: With three-dot diff semantics a change made on the base branch is not attributed to this branch. Confirms the guard does not manufacture false positives from divergence.

git_cases.description: Merge a branch that changed a protected file, then diff from the pinned base.
git_cases.rationale: Content merged in from a side branch is present in the head tree and must be attributed.

git_cases.description: Invoke the guard with the all-zero base SHA that GitHub sends as github.event.before on branch creation.
git_cases.rationale: The workflow passes github.event.before directly. On branch creation that value is all zeros. Fail-closed exit 2 is correct; exit 0 would be a false green.

git_cases.description: Run the guard over a range with no changes at all.
git_cases.rationale: An empty change set must pass rather than error.

git_cases.description: Leave an out-of-allowlist modification uncommitted in the working tree.
git_cases.rationale: The guard compares commits, so uncommitted work is out of its remit. Recorded to bound the guard's claim, not as a defect.

git_cases.description: Stage an out-of-allowlist modification without committing it.
git_cases.rationale: Same boundary as GIT-027 for the index rather than the working tree.
